title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1671: Daofuse falls (2)

section.p: At the same time.
Outside the Celestial Chasm Realm.

The Divine Pseudo Emperor and Tiangu arrived. Shortly after, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis arrived as well. Three Daofuses. Including the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor inside, there were four Daofuses here as well.
Suddenly, an opening in the air appeared nearby. Then, a furball with a shifty expression peeked out of the hole.
Tiangu indifferently said, “Soy Bun, if you interfere, you will be the first we kill today.”

There were three of them, with Tiangu and the Heavenly Overseer Marquis being individuals who Soy Bun had personally admitted to be stronger than him. The Divine Pseudo Emperor wasn’t too weak either.
Soy Bun was all alone currently since Flatbun was at the Human Realm.
“Why don’t we just kill him first?”
The Divine Pseudo Emperor laughed and said, “Senior Soy Bun has always been a firm ally of humanity. We might as well take this chance and eliminate him while the other furball isn’t around.”

At that, the three started approaching Soy Bun slowly. This was indeed their best chance to kill Soy Bun. In fact, even losing the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor to kill Soy Bun would be a worthy trade for them.
Slow, Soy Bun started pulling back.
He could sense an incoming crisis.
An extreme crisis.
He was very powerful and ancient. But he still wasn’t a match for three Daofuses.

At the moment, the Invincibles who had arrived with the three Daofuses were busy attacking the realm barrier. They were trying to pierce through the barrier and free the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor.

If they weren’t stopped and the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor was allowed to flee, humanity’s plan would fail. All they would have accomplished was killing some Invincibles. That was pointless since the biggest threat originated from Daofuses.
Soy Bun was placed in a dilemma.
What now?
Should he leave?
He could leave, but that would allow the three Daofuses to easily break through the realm barrier.
Soy Bun said with a pitiful expression, “Don’t hit me! You can’t attack the Celestial Chasm Realm! The death spirits will come out! Everyone will be punished by the heavenly laws!”

Tiangu laughed and said, “No worries. We can still use our assembly tokens a few times. We only need to keep the heavenly laws silent for a bit while we kill the humans and drive the death spirits back to the Death Realm.”
Soy Bun continued hesitating.
What a strong argument.
Were the humans too brash this time?
This was so troublesome.
At this rate, Great Qin King and the others would die.

Those outside could already sense the death spirit disturbance in the Celestial Chasm Realm. It would only be a matter of time before the combination of death spirits and heavenly laws killed everyone inside. But leaving would be a bad choice either with so many Daofuses and Invincibles waiting.
Soy Bun knew that at his departure, the humans would be faced with four Daofuses, making things even harder for them. Yes, seizing the alternative was a good idea. But strength was required, right?

Soy Bun couldn’t make up his mind. Seeing that the three Daofuses were getting nearer and nearer, he decided to first withdraw. It would be pointless for him to die here as well. That wouldn’t help anyone.
Just then, the space nearby warped.
Then, the space was ripped open, followed by someone stepping out of it.
The newcomer was gigantic.
A primordial giant.
The king of the primordial giants.
The expressions of Tiangu and the others changed. Slowly, the giant stepped forth, the sounds of his steps echoing everywhere.
“Zhou Tianqi, I’m here.”
The Daofuse giant coldly said, “Tiangu, if war is what you want, so be it. I’ll be glad to oblige.”
Tiangu asked with surprise, “Why are you here?”
The leader of the primordial giants was known as a king, not an Emperor. This was a race without an Emperor. However, their king was a Daofuse.
The primordial giant said, “I felt like coming. So I came.”
The Divine Pseudo Emperor said, “The primordial giants were one of the races that had attacked humanity during the previous epoch. What are you thinking?”

They weren’t saying so much because they were scared. Rather, they were genuinely surprised. It was normal for one to pick sides during a war. But the primordial giants had fought against the humans during the previous epoch. In fact, they were even involved in the final battle against the Hundred Battle King. Thus, nobody had imagined that they would make such a decision in this epoch.

This was completely different from the iron devourers. They were completely unsurprised that the iron devourers would side with the humans. They had been staying neutral for many years and they had never stood against the humans.
They were truly surprised by the choice of the primordial giants.
Why?
Was it something like faith?
No.
If that were the case, they wouldn’t have joined the attack against the humans during the previous epoch.

One should never mistake their refusal to appoint an Emperor as their loyalty to the ancient Human Emperor. They were simply too proud of their ancient heritage that they refused to embrace the title of an Emperor. According to their history, they hailed from a time where Emperors did not exist, an era known as the primordial era instead of the ancient past.
Their pride in their history was why they called themselves the primordial giants.
They were never close to humanity.
Thus, many were surprised by their choice.
“Did Zhou Tianqi do something?”
The Primordial Giant King said nothing. He continued stepping forward with a large axe in hand. “I suggest we all wait until a result is decided in there.”
“Just because the two of you are here?”
Tiangu chuckled and said, “You’re not weak. Soy Bun isn’t weak either. But…are you enough to stop us?”
“What if you include me?”
Just then, yet another person stepped out of thin air.
“Spatial beast!”

Tiangu was shocked. He looked at the newly arrived old man and sternly asked, “Are you standing with the humans as well? Your descendant, Hollow, stole a treasure from me. I spared him out of respect for you. You should have been tactful enough to not stand in my way. What a surprise. Why did you make such an unwise decision?”
Three ancient races had actually chosen to side with the humans. This was inconceivable. They couldn’t believe it.

Humanity was in a terrible state. It would be understandable for some races to make this choice in the ninth epoch, as humanity was very powerful back then. But this was the tenth epoch. This was an inconceivable choice.

It wouldn’t be surprising for anyone to stand with the mighty Hundred Battle King during the ninth epoch. But what would be their reason to stand with the humans in this epoch? This was an epoch where humanity had not produced a single Daofuse.
Why did they pick the humans?
Were they simply feeling like courting death?
Even the Heavenly Overseer Marquis was confused by this choice. “Space Devourer, I don’t understand your choice.”

The old man replied nonchalantly, “There is nothing confusing about this. The humans might be overbearing and arrogant, but ancient races like us can only continue existing with them around. The moment they are gone, there will be nothing to hold you back from acting against us.”

He looked around and said, “The humans are overly domineering, but they are also unique. So unique that they can enter all realms without suffering from any suppressive force. Thus, they will never bother to fight with the intent to destroy a realm completely.” “You are different. You can’t suppress the myriad races like the humans did due to the suppressive force. Upon victory, you will have to destroy the realms of all the other races to keep your dominance.”
For the humans, it was pointless to destroy the realms of those they ruled since they could always defeat their subjects again without worrying about the suppressive force of the various realms.

That wouldn’t be the case for the immortals, divines, or any other race. They wouldn’t hesitate to destroy the realms of their subjects to keep their subjects under control. For many races, hope would exist so long as their realms continued existing. But without their realms, all hope would be lost. It would only be a matter of time before they went extinct.
Tiangu frowned and said, “Space Devourer, how can you make such an important decision based on such an uncertain speculation on the future?”

“The future is always uncertain.” The old man said, “The defeat of humanity is not certain either. But I am sure about one thing. Upon the victory of humanity, we simply need to submit and we will survive. The same can’t be said if you win.”
“Ridiculous.” Tiangu said, “What a ridiculous reasoning. Space Devourer, I can’t understand your choice.”

“No, not ridiculous at all.” The old man said, “I understand very well that my race does not have what it takes to dominate the Myriad Realms. We don’t have enough experts here or beyond. The Myriad Realms do not belong to us. No. The Myriad Realms belong to the humans, divines, devils, immortals, dragons, and the other major races. You have enough numbers to dominate. You breed fast enough to dominate. The humans breed the fastest, but the divines, devils, and immortals are almost as fast. The dragons are slightly slower, but there are still a lot of them around. But there aren’t a lot of us around.”

Yes. That was the biggest issue of the ancient races. They did not have the numbers to dominate the Myriad Realms. They would never be the ones to win this struggle. But at the very least, their realms would endure at the event of a human victory. That alone was enough for the spatial beasts to make this choice.
Tiangu was left speechless.
He looked at the three experts before him speechlessly.
He suspected that they had already reached an agreement with the humans before this or they wouldn’t have appeared so quickly. They felt way too decisive for this to be a recent decision.
He inhaled deeply and asked, “Did Great Zhou King visit all of you? Did he somehow persuade you all to help?”
Both the spatial beast and the primordial giant stayed silent. If Tiangu wanted the answer so much, he could guess.
Tiangu laughed and said, “How…surprising.”
The human race was indeed worthy of being a race that had once conquered the Myriad Realms.
A starving camel would still be bigger than a healthy horse. Even after so many years of decline, they were still capable of garnering the support of these Daofuses.
Tiangu sighed again and said, “Looks like the time has really arrived for the myriad races to make a choice. Friends, what about you? What will you choose?”
So far, fourteen Daofuses had appeared.
Six outside the Celestial Chasm Realm, six outside the Human Realm, and one each in the two realms.
Essentially, the majority of the Daofuses in the Myriad Realms had emerged.
And they had all chosen.
However, a few Daofuses were still nowhere to be seen.

Such as the Fate Pseudo Emperor, Phoenix Pseudo Emperor, Heavenly Spirit Ape Pseudo Emperor, Golden Peng Pseudo Emperor, and Hou Pseudo Emperor. A large number of these Daofuses came from the ancient races. However, the ancient races had a lower number of Invincibles compared to the major races. This was why most ancient races were only concerned about self-preservation instead of domination and conquest.
Apart from the major and ancient races, there were also unique races with a lot of Invincibles yet without a Daofuse. The five elemental race was one such race.

Next, several ancient fossils awakened from their coffins in the Immortal Realm. They weren’t Daofuses, but they were ninth-degree Eternals. After leaving their coffins, they left their realm and moved in the direction of Tiangu.

At the same time, several ancient ninth-degree Eternals emerged from the Divine Realm. The gap between a Daofuse and a ninth-degree Eternal wasn’t too big, but it was big enough for one Daofuse to handle three to five ninth-degree Eternals.
For example, Great Zhou King and Great Qin King were as good as multiple ninth-degree Eternals. That was why the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor was having such a hard time against them.
Naturally, the surviving ancient fossils of the major races were no weaklings either. The humans might be able to garner the support of Daofuses, but what about ninth-degree Eternals?

The ancient races were known for their low number of Eternals. That was the biggest distinction between an ancient race and a major race. Just then, a screech rang out as a gigantic phoenix appeared in the sky before landing beside Tiangu.

The phoenix transformed into a female humanoid before sighing. “Since all of you have chosen, I must choose as well. The phoenixes do not wish to stand against you, but we are also unwilling to see the humans rise again.”
She was the fifteenth Daofuse to appear today. Among them, six were standing on humanity’s side. The humans were also outnumbered in terms of Invincibles.
